listing.name: Downhill Domination — Downhill Domination Recomp (ekansh28) (ekansh28)
listing.summary: Experimental Downhill Domination source project. Upstream reports reaching PRESS X TO START, but pressing X crashes and no race is playable. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS-97177 disc and extracted ELF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream Linux source-build instructions to create the Ghidra function map, generate configuration and build the native player from your extracted USA game. No ready-to-use package is confirmed.

warnings: Upstream reports reaching the textured PRESS X TO START screen, followed by a crash when pressing X. No playable race is available.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
